Intel: extract structure from Rust function definition

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"rust\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("fn add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {\n    a + b\n}\n", config)
    println(result.language)
    println(result.structure)
    println(result.structure.first().kind)
    println(result.metrics.totalLines)
    println(result.metrics.errorCount)
}
```
